Full industrial kitchen Gathering space- room for 100- 150 people Office space for 10 Restrooms Two 6-8-stalled restrooms for male/female (accommodates ~160 people) 1 restroom near kitchen (~10) 1 restroom within office space or near (~10) Loading dock with unloading room Exhibition prep space Recording space (audio/video) Key code/badge access for each space/room and to enter/close building. Additional spaces to consider: Gift shop Cafe Outside space: Ethnobotanical plants relevant for food Plants for healing Native species Pathway around space Parking Class/gathering space

title: Architectural Design Services for Museum Facility
short_description: Design services for a large museum and cultural center facility in Black River Falls.
project_scope: Museum and cultural center facility for the Ho-Chunk Nation. The program includes a 25,000 sq ft storage facility with integrated research room, office and researcher room, humidity control, temperature control, secure access, fire suppression, water and air quality control, a large walk-in freezer for incoming objects, and cold storage for a seed bank. Cultural center spaces include a 15,000 sq ft main gallery, 6,000 sq ft temporary gallery, 2-4 classrooms for 25-30 students each with water/sinks and smartboard/e-classroom capability and outdoor access, 6,000 sq ft library and archival space/storage with 2 workstations and research work area, full industrial kitchen, gathering space for 100-150 people, office space for 10 staff, multiple restrooms, loading dock with unloading room, exhibition preparation space, recording space for audio/video, key code/badge access, gift shop, cafe, ethnobotanical planting areas, healing and native species planting, pathway, parking, and outdoor class/gathering space. Approximate stated indoor area totals at least 52,000 sq ft plus ancillary spaces.
services: Architectural design services; blueprints/design for the museum facility; all disciplines requested.
relevance_explanation:
- Large and complex cultural building with museum, archive, galleries, classrooms, kitchen, storage, and specialized environmental controls.
- Cultural/public building type is strategically relevant to sbp, especially larger architecturally demanding facilities.
- Early-stage design procurement can offer entry into the planning team.
- Includes technically demanding spaces such as archival storage, cold rooms, loading/exhibition prep, and recording spaces.
- However, the notice is focused on architectural design services and does not explicitly request structural engineering or special long-span structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. Useful scope indicators for a rough estimate: at least 52,000 sq ft of stated indoor program area plus ancillary spaces such as gift shop, cafe, circulation, plant rooms, and exterior works. The facility includes museum/gallery spaces, archival storage, industrial kitchen, specialized humidity and temperature control, fire suppression, secure access, cold storage, loading dock, and landscape/outdoor gathering areas, which suggest above-average building costs.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender documents. The procurement is for architectural design services with all disciplines requested, but no budget, fee basis, or percentage is provided.
references_qualifications: Qualified and committed professional firm or individual(s) experienced in architectural design services. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Ho-Chunk Nation, Black River Falls, Wisconsin, USA. Contact: Dakota Walton-Smith. Phone: 800-779-2873. Fax: 715-284-4291. Email: Dakota.walton-smith@ho-chunk.com. Website: https://ho-chunknation.com/rfp-bid/14034/
